source.source_type: Official organizer document, retrieved from public Uganda science foundation mirror; original organizer headers and document content preserved.

verified.prepared_TrueType_audit_remaining_cases: Only Helvetica/NimbusSans-Regular, independently covered by exact prepared CFF bytes and actual trace GIDs.
verified.final_appearance_reuse: 38 pages exactly 2x-RGB-identical to the already fully reviewed complete edition; final pages 3,8,27,28,36 rendered, OCRed and visually inspected again.
verified.both_rendering_engines: All 43 pages rendered in MuPDF and Poppler; updated final five pages rerendered in both. Poppler returns 0; local fontconfig warning set retained in renderer report.

layout_and_font_method.source_page_design: Original 43 page dimensions, artwork, figures, source data, tables, form blanks, print identifiers and accents retained. Descriptive text replaced in its corresponding native positions.
layout_and_font_method.native_scientific_material: 85 unscaled native fragments, 241 source glyphs: original font programs/GIDs/sizes/relative positions preserved. Complex display equations remain original raster artwork.
layout_and_font_method.new_Korean_fonts: Noto Sans KR regular/bold; oblique variants where original roles are italic.
layout_and_font_method.new_Latin: Original source faces explicitly routed per character with independent Unicode/GID/outline/metrics and requested style checks. Base14 Helvetica is the local MuPDF standard face; inserted Helvetica counterpart uses verified exact NimbusSans CFF program.
layout_and_font_method.bitmap_labels: 141 descriptive label overlays including 125 periodic table labels; masks and insertion rectangles recorded in paper-raster-labels.json; original bitmap image and SMask streams retained.
layout_and_font_method.bitmap_font_limit: Original bitmap font programs are unavailable. Sans/weight/slant roles use available source faces; START cannot use a missing source ArialBold glyph subset and uses document-native bold Trebuchet sans.

intentional_translation_layout_adjustmen: Page 27 first paragraph begins 6 pt lower within the existing whitespace to keep new Korean ascenders below the original header rule; native image and rule positions unchanged.
Page 28 column heading Fe(III) mole fraction is Korean in natural word order within the same original cell. Page 36 present/absent labels stay in original first gray cells.
The periodic table retains original historical Uut/Uup/Uus/Uuo symbols. All four source unknown values are translated as 미상; the adjacent Lv (298) is preserved as originally printed.
Original glossary statement that defines starch grain as a plastid is translated literally; no editorial scientific correction or extra answer hint is inserted.
Literal spoken commands, team/container/device identifiers and organizer logos remain identifiable; descriptive labels and ordinary prose are translated.
